about.hero_paragraph: I’m a graphic designer passionate about visual storytelling, typography, and thoughtful branding that helps people connect with ideas.
about.story_paragraph: I’ve always been drawn to the way a single layout, a well-chosen typeface, or a simple mark can turn a message into a memory. As a graphic designer, I partner with clients to craft visual systems that feel intentional, clear, and human.
about.strength1_paragraph: I help brands find their voice through logos, color systems, typography, and guidelines that scale from business cards to websites.
about.strength2_paragraph: From posters and brochures to social assets and websites, I design across mediums with a focus on consistency and impact.
about.strength3_paragraph: I believe type is the foundation of good design. I love pairing fonts, setting hierarchies, and refining layouts that read beautifully.
